sections.title: Part 1
sections.instructions: You should spend about 20 minutes on this task. Write at least 150 words.

questions.title: The bar chart below shows the estimated illiteracy rates in Bangladesh, by division and by gender, in the last year.
questions.question: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

sections.title: Part 2
sections.instructions: You should spend about 40 minutes on this task. Write at least 250 words.

questions.title: Some species of animals are almost extinct; and many others seem to be fast approaching a similar risk.
questions.question:
What are the reasons for this? 

 What should be done to solve this problem? Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge and experience.
